tasks.answer: Use DeleteDiscussion (feature-level destructive confirmation control for deleting a discussion, built on the shared ConfirmationDialog; ConfirmationDialog itself requires triggerButton, confirmButton and title).

The login form uses the shared Input. It binds to react-hook-form through its required `registration` prop: pass register('email') / register('password') from the form render-prop, and Input spreads the returned UseFormRegisterReturn onto the native input; label/error are rendered via FieldWrapper.
The discussion list uses TablePagination, which needs totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl (it builds page hrefs from the root URL and current page).
MDPreview renders Markdown as sanitized HTML with prose typography; it takes the Markdown source through the `value` prop.
CreateDiscussion is an admin-only drawer form (requires the ADMIN role/authorization); it takes no required props and creates a discussion with a title and Markdown body.

notes: One search per task, plus a single extra search for task 2 (first search returned form wrappers, not the input), then one multi-ID get (ui.form.Input, ui.form.Form) to confirm the registration-based RHF binding. No source files read; no --include props used.
